title: BridgeResponse
description: CONTRACTS §5.3 response envelope returned to JS. `status` discriminates the body: `ok` carries `result` (sync commands), `accepted` carries `job_id` (long jobs), `error` carries `error`. Exactly one body slot is populated per §5.4; unused slots are absent, never null.

request_id.description: Correlation id copied from the request; an empty string is allowed only for a pre-envelope failure the facade could not attribute to a valid request.

result.description: Command result body; present iff status == ok.

job_id.description: Async job handle; present iff status == accepted (§5.2 accepted + job_id).

error.description: Typed error body; present iff status == error.
